note: T6 stock-token fragment farm. Fragments are internal claim chips, not ERC-20 and not a game-NVDA. Pool is real ERC-20 bought outside the tick. Claim window is fragment_window_city_days, never payroll_daily_divisor.

protocol_fragments_bps.why: Legacy route split retained for pack compatibility; spend_protocol_bps is now zero, so this route has no live funding

protocol_prizes_bps.why: Legacy route split retained for pack compatibility; the live month kettle is funded by the 20 bps creator-tax leaderboard leg, not this disabled route

fragment_creator_tax_share_bps.why: Creator tax body feeds payroll via buyback. The increment of the 2% rate is seasons.prize_creator_tax_share_bps, not fragments. Diverting the body would starve the wage fund

active_work_creator_tax_bps.why: 60 bps of turnover from the 200 bps creator tax goes to the active-work stock pool (farm 0.6%); leaderboard is the residual 20 bps after studio 20. Runtime converts this direct turnover bps from tax atoms using creator_tax_bps

fragment_cork_share_bps.why: Fund cork is a recovery channel for payroll, not a prize tap. Divergence from LAUNCH §10 is named R-T6-1

fragment_nft_share_bps.why: G6 fixed the crane at zero (D-G-9). NFT proceeds close the inference bill; a fragment share would promise yield the protocol cannot hold

fragment_hop_haircut_bps.why: Conservative floor from the 10 000$ extra-leg measurement so a large tranche still holds the invariant

fragment_city_cap_bps.why: When at least two cities claim, one city takes at most half the window pool. N=1 is uncapped so the first player is not taxed for being alone

fragment_window_city_days.why: Owner weekly farm settle. Seven city days is 175 real hours. Payroll daily budget stays fund/14; gluing the two clocks would double wage spend

weth_quote_ticker.why: COIN is the one ticker whose deepest quote leg is WETH not USDG. One name, not six authored routes

derived.protocol_split_total_bps: legacy protocol_fragments_bps + protocol_prizes_bps, must be 10000; live spend_protocol_bps is 0
derived.quote_asset_by_ticker: WETH if ticker == weth_quote_ticker else USDG, from districts[].ticker
derived.fragment_ledgers_v1: tickers of districts with playable_v1, not a hand list of three
derived.fragment_window_budget: DEX turnover for the farm window × active-work leg × hop haircut, using the T1 low/mid/hype monthly scenarios
derived.fragment_sources: live taps: creator-tax active-work 50 bps; legacy spend_protocol 0; cork 0; nft 0
derived.fragment_accrual_probe: paid beacon playable >0; workshop, synergy, IDLE, construction, non-playable = 0
derived.fragment_season_method: produced × fragment_rate stack, never paper-magnitude proxy
derived.settle_hour: efficiency_recalc_hour, first hour of a new window
derived.hop_haircut_bps: copy of the param for generated tables, not a second stored hop table
derived.demo_claim_real: 0: demo ledger is isolated, DEMO_NO_CLAIM on real ERC-20
